pageHeader.title: Roles & Permissions
pageHeader.description: Every role as a column, every capability as a row. Tick a box to grant it, untick to take it away — changes save immediately and apply on the affected user's next request.

permissionDenied.title: You can't manage roles
permissionDenied.description: Your account's role doesn't include "Manage roles & permissions". Ask an administrator to grant it if you need access to this screen.

matrix.title: Capabilities by role
matrix.scrollHint: Scroll right to see every role →
matrix.deleteSeededTooltip: Built-in roles can't be deleted from this screen.
matrix.recoveryCapabilityHint: Removing everyone's last holder of this capability locks administrators out — the panel refuses that change and tells you why.

roleFormDialog.createDescription: Name the role, then choose which capabilities it grants. You can change both later.
roleFormDialog.renameDescription: This changes the role's display name everywhere it's shown.

deleteRoleDialog.title: Delete "{{name}}"?
deleteRoleDialog.descriptionNoMembers: This role has no members. Deleting it cannot be undone.
deleteRoleDialog.descriptionWithMembers_one: {{count}} user currently holds this role. Choose a role to move them to first — deleting cannot be undone.
deleteRoleDialog.descriptionWithMembers_other: {{count}} users currently hold this role. Choose a role to move them to first — deleting cannot be undone.
deleteRoleDialog.reassignTip: Every member of this role moves to the one you pick here, all at once — there's no way to split them across different roles from this dialog. To send people to different roles individually, cancel and use the "Assign roles to users" table below instead.
deleteRoleDialog.reassignExceedsYours: You don't hold every capability this role grants, so you can't move members into it.

confirmSelfCapabilityLoss.title: This removes your own access
confirmSelfCapabilityLoss.description: You currently hold this capability yourself. Going through with this change removes your own ability to {{action}} — you'll keep every other permission you have now.

userAssignment.title: Assign roles to users
userAssignment.description: Change which role a user account holds.

permissionDenied.title: Can't list user accounts
permissionDenied.description: Your account's role doesn't include "Manage user accounts". Ask an administrator to grant it, or sign in as an account that already holds it.

toasts.roleDeletedReassignedDescription: "{{name}}" was deleted and its members moved to "{{target}}".

manage.label: Manage user accounts
manage.description: Create accounts, list them, change which role each one holds, and permanently delete an account.

manage.label: Manage roles & permissions
manage.description: Create, edit and delete roles, and choose which capabilities each one grants.

manage.label: Create, delete & configure backups
manage.description: Create manual backups, delete or prune old ones, upload external backups, and change the backup schedule.

download.label: Download a backup archive
download.description: Download a backup .zip off the machine — a full copy of the world save and, if database backups are turned on, the panel's own account data. A different act from creating, deleting or restoring one: this one leaves the machine.

restore.label: Restore a backup
restore.description: Roll the live world back to an earlier backup — affects every player currently on the server.

control.label: Start, stop, restart & save the server
control.description: Start, stop, force-stop, restart or save the running server — however it is deployed, including a Docker-managed one. Docker container status, stats and direct container actions are a separate capability (docker.manage).

install.label: Install & update the server
install.description: Install or update the server through SteamCMD, browse the filesystem to configure it, and verify a discovered install.

configure.label: Edit server configuration
configure.description: Edit the server's .ini settings, RCON connection details, and network/path configuration, and reload the server's Lua scripts on a live server.

wipe.label: Wipe the world
wipe.description: Irreversibly delete map, player or world save data — including, via the 'clear install folder' action, an install directory that passes a PZ-install marker-file check AND matches a configured server's own recorded install path.

world_events.label: Run world events
world_events.description: Weather, climate, time of day, ambient sound, world-wide alarms, gunshots and helicopter events, zombie hordes (clearing them, not spawning them at anyone), releasing safehouses, utilities, visual settings and server-attributed broadcast messages — world-wide effects, not aimed at a specific player. It also reads the live server console log (and its error count) and the game's update check. Spawning zombies or sound effects at a named player, targeted lightning/thunder, and impersonating a player in chat are a separate capability, players.endanger_or_impersonate.

execute.label: Run RCON commands
execute.description: Connect to RCON and execute arbitrary console commands, including ones that can stop the server. Also grants read access to the full RCON command history — including real player passwords typed into whitelist commands like adduser. With Discipline players, it also grants in-game staff access levels such as admin.

manage.label: Add, edit & remove configured servers
manage.description: Add, edit, remove or activate a configured server entry.

discover.label: Auto-discover servers on this machine
discover.description: Scan any path on the host filesystem you specify for PZ server installs, including reading and parsing the contents of the .ini config files it finds there.

manage.label: Manage server templates
manage.description: Create, import, apply and delete configuration templates.

setup.label: Connect & configure PanelBridge
setup.description: Connect or reconfigure the in-game mod bridge — including entering and storing the SFTP login password used to reach a remote server, browsing arbitrary paths on that server over SFTP, and pointing the local bridge at any absolute host path outside a small blocked-directory list. Also installs the mod and chooses how it is delivered (panel-installed or Steam Workshop), which edits Mods=, WorkshopItems= and DoLuaChecksum in the server's settings file.

diagnostics.label: PanelBridge diagnostics
diagnostics.description: View the mod's debug log and stats, introspect its API, available handlers and item scripts, run item and vehicle catalog scans, toggle its debug mode, and clear its error log.

command.label: Run any PanelBridge action
command.description: The unrestricted passthrough behind every in-game tool, including ones with no dedicated button.

moderate.label: Discipline players
moderate.description: Ban, unban, kick or whitelist a player, and set a player's in-game access level to a plain one such as user or priority. Granting a staff level (admin, moderator, gm, observer or a custom role with more powers), or changing the level of an account that has one, also needs Run RCON commands: those levels run server console commands in game.

gm_tools.label: Game-master tools
gm_tools.description: Spawn items, teleport, and similar trusted event-runner actions.

view.label: View player info
view.description: Read player details, status and history, including each character's skills, XP, traits and inventory.

endanger_or_impersonate.label: Endanger or impersonate a player
endanger_or_impersonate.description: Spawn up to 500 zombies directly at a named player's location or right behind them, or trigger a horde aimed at them; aim a gunshot or an attraction sound at their position; strike them with targeted lightning or thunder. Separately, and a different kind of harm: send a general-chat message under any custom author name, including another player's — making it read as if that player said it themselves.

manage.label: Manage mods
manage.description: Track, install, configure and permanently delete Workshop mods from disk — including extracting or overwriting the Steam login session used for Workshop uploads, up to pulling it directly from an installed browser's cookie store on this machine.

manage.label: Manage scheduled tasks
manage.description: Create and edit automated restarts, backups and other scheduled jobs.

manage.label: Manage integrations
manage.description: Configure the Discord bot and similar external hooks.

manage.label: Manage the Docker container
manage.description: View Docker container status and stats, and run direct container actions from the Docker screen. Starting, stopping and restarting the server itself — Docker-managed or not — is governed by server.control, not this capability.

manage.label: Manage map chunks
manage.description: Clean up or delete map chunk regions, including from an arbitrary host directory you specify — not limited to this server's own configured save location — and configure the chunk save path.

manage.label: Edit server config files
manage.description: Edit sandbox options, spawn points and other server config files.

manage.label: Manage server files
manage.description: Browse, download, upload, edit, rename and delete any file in each server's game install and Zomboid folders — on this computer, through Docker mounts, and on the active remote server over its PanelBridge SFTP login. That includes world saves, the player database and the game's own Java and Lua files, which run under the server's account at its next start, so treat it like the admin password. The panel's own data, logs and secrets and the World Backups folder stay out of reach, and it is refused while panel logins are turned off.

manage.label: View panel diagnostics
manage.description: View logs, performance history, CORS diagnostics and database statistics, back up the database, compact it — which permanently trims old records — and clear stale lock files. Also relocates the panel's data and log directories to any writable path on the host (blocked only from OS system directories and a configured server's own folders), and can move everything already there in the process — including the JWT signing secret, every server's stored RCON password, and the main database.

settings.label: Manage panel-wide settings
settings.description: Change CORS policy, mod-check interval and other app-level settings — including pointing the panel's HTTPS listener at any certificate/key file on the host — and the SSO/OIDC sign-in button's name and scope. Which identity provider signs people in (issuer, client ID and secret, redirect URI) stays admin-only.
